Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) are structured documents with specific sections. Section 1 typically deals with chemical identification and includes:

1. The name of the chemical (Product identifier)
2. CAS number (Chemical Abstracts Service Registry Number)
3. Name and address of the manufacturer/supplier
4. Emergency contact number

The toxicity information is typically found in a different section (often Section 11: Toxicological Information), not in the chemical identification section.

Looking at the options:
A. CAS nr. of the chemical - This IS included in the chemical identification section
B. Emergency contact number - This IS included in the chemical identification section
C. Name and address of the manufacturer - This IS included in the chemical identification section
D. Name of the chemical - This IS included in the chemical identification section
E. Toxicity of the ingredients of the chemical - This is NOT included in the chemical identification section, but rather in the toxicological information section

Therefore, the answer is E. Toxicity of the ingredients of the chemical.
